{{Youmay|the personal starship of Darth Bane|the [[Mystic (force adept)|term]] for a [[Force Adept]]}}
The '''''Mystic''''' was the personal [[Infiltrator-series long-range fighter|''Infiltrator''-series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|long-range fighter]] of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. He acquired it through one of his various contacts. The ship was a medium-sized starfighter. It had light weapons and minimal plating, to focus on speed and maneuverability. The ship had a Class Four [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and could hold up to six passengers.
